title: TikTok Shop product and seller extraction
description: Enter TikTok Shop product IDs or paste public product, storefront or category URLs. US is the only validated market.

startUrls.title: TikTok Shop URLs
startUrls.description: Public TikTok Shop product, storefront (including the seller slug), or category URLs. Store and category URLs supply products from the first page.

productIds.title: Product IDs
productIds.description: Optional list of 19-digit TikTok Shop product IDs. Keep them as strings so the digits are not rounded.

region.title: Marketplace
region.description: Applied to product IDs and legacy URLs. Canonical URLs retain their own market. Only US results have been validated.

maxItems.title: Maximum product rows
maxItems.description: Maximum number of unique product records. Store records are billed separately and do not count towards this cap.

maxProductsPerListing.title: Products per storefront or category
maxProductsPerListing.description: Maximum product detail requests from each first-page listing. Set to 0 for stores only, without following their products.

includeReviews.title: Include embedded reviews
includeReviews.description: Include the public review sample embedded on the product page when present. Rating and review counts are collected either way.

includeRelatedVideos.title: Include related videos
includeRelatedVideos.description: Include related TikTok videos when embedded. Product gallery videos are collected either way.

includeRaw.title: Include raw product data
includeRaw.description: Add the source product component to each product row. This makes exports larger and may include public metadata not present in normalized fields.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Defaults to Apify Proxy on the platform. Disable the proxy for local runs without Apify credentials.

maxRetries.title: HTTP retries
maxRetries.description: HTTP retries per URL before trying a bounded browser fallback. The first HTTP attempt is not included.
